transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well... nice to meet you too. I guess I'm here because of some things going on at my job. I'm a transportation inspector, and... well, ever since I won this county safety award a little while back, things have been off. 

Certain people at work have been... twisting my inspection reports. They keep asking me these really pointed budget questions, like they’re trying to make me look crooked or something. I brought it up to my supervisor, and he said it’s just a normal review process, but... I can tell. I know what I'm seeing. There’s a coordinated effort to discredit me. So... yeah. That's what brings me in.
Aside from the behavior of your coworkers, have you been hearing any voices or sounds that other people around you don't seem to hear?
No. I don't... I don't hear anything like that. Just what people are actually saying. I'm not hearing voices, if that's what you mean.
Have you always felt that people around you are generally untrustworthy, or is this feeling of being targeted something that only started recently?
No, I... I haven't always felt this way. It's just... it's been about a year. Ever since I got recognized for that county safety initiative. That's when it all started.

If your supervisor were to show you definitive proof that the budget questions are part of a routine, automated audit and not a personal attack, would you be willing to consider that your interpretation might be mistaken?

I... I don't think so. I mean, they can show me whatever paperwork they want. But I know what's happening. Like I said, it started right after that safety award. They twist my reports, they ask those specific budget questions... it's not random. My supervisor can call it a normal review all he wants, but I know what I see. It's coordinated. They're trying to make me look crooked, and... a piece of paper saying it's an audit doesn't change what they're actually doing.
Are there any other areas of your life, outside of your work environment, where you feel that people or organizations are working against you or acting with hidden motives?
No. Just work. It's... it's only at work. I don't have problems anywhere else.

Outside of these concerns about your coworkers, have you noticed any changes in your ability to handle your daily responsibilities, such as keeping up with household chores, maintaining your personal hygiene, or interacting with friends and family?

No, I... I do fine. I still get to work on time. Do my inspections. I still go to church on Sundays, keep the house clean... take care of myself. It's just... it's just when those reports come up, or when they start asking about my spending. That's when it gets bad. But everything else is normal.
